title: SkillLevelDefinition - Data API
description: Represents a skill which can be acquired by completing enablement site (myTrailhead) modules. This object is available in API version 51.0 and later.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

IsAutoApproved.description: Whether this mapping auto-approves. The default value is 'false'.

LearningContent.description: The titles of the Trailhead modules associated to this mapping.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The user who owns the Skill Level Definition. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

SkillId.description: The skill that this mapping is for. This is a relationship field.

SkillLevel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SkillLevel.description: The level to assign for the skill.
